macos.expiry: exp claim of the access token JWT, epochSeconds; a local hint only
macos.notes: The id_token's claims carry email and https://api.openai.com/auth.chatgpt_plan_type for the account row.

windows.expiry: exp claim of the access token JWT, epochSeconds

windows.label: {limit_window_seconds → 5h limit | Weekly limit | Monthly limit | Nd limit | Nm limit}
windows.notes: Fallback reset: reset_after_seconds from now. A present window without used_percent is a bad response. The label derives from limit_window_seconds, never assumed: a free plan's only window is a 30-day one.

sessions.macos: ~/.codex/state_5.sqlite (threads.rollout_path, archived=0, order by updated_at_ms) and ~/.codex/sqlite/codex-dev.db (local_thread_catalog.source_updated_at in fractional seconds, display_title)
sessions.windows: same paths under the user profile
sessions.notes: No status field exists; a rollout file or catalogue row written within 8 seconds means a turn is running. One session at most, the newest of the two sources. Never 'waiting'.

status.notice: Uses the ChatGPT session the Codex CLI holds.
